Survival basics

What biomes exist in the game and how do they differ?

  • Winter - A snow-covered biome where cold weather drains your health, and the effect intensifies the deeper you venture into it. Nights are especially dangerous. However, this biome has higher ore density and is the only place to find Ice Shards. Player density tends to be lower here. To survive, wear Leather Armor for warmth, place Campfires and Furnaces near your base, and avoid prolonged exposure without protection.
  • Desert - A sandy biome with scarce vegetation. The heat causes hunger and thirst to deplete faster than in other areas. Always carry plenty of food and water supplies when exploring the desert.
  • Forest - A green, balanced biome with the most trees and a wide variety of resources. It's the most popular area for building bases, but the high player and animal density makes it more dangerous and competitive.
  • Water - Water areas significantly slow your movement but are the primary source of fish.
